eyebrow.zh: 本地跑前沿中文开源大模型 · 换模型不再重配
eyebrow.en: Run frontier Chinese open-source models locally · no reconfig per swap

headline.zh:
换个模型，要重配 5 小时？
一条命令，选对、跑起。
headline.en:
5 hours to reconfigure every model swap?
One command picks right and runs it.

sub.zh: 每换一个前沿中文开源大模型，你都要重解同一道题：量化、后端、对话模板怎么搭——手写一遍，上游一补丁就静默过时。zerorun 看清你的显卡，替你一次配对，直接拉起。
sub.en: Every swap to a new frontier Chinese open-source model reopens the same puzzle: which quantization, backend, and chat template fit — hand-configured once, silently stale after the next upstream patch. zerorun reads your GPU, picks the match, and just runs it.

title.zh: 看清你的显卡能跑什么
title.en: See what your card can actually run

body.zh: 自动读取显存与算力，告诉你哪个模型放得下、哪种配置跑得动；没 NVIDIA 卡也能模拟一张大卡预演挑选结果。
body.en: Reads your VRAM and compute, tells you which model fits and which config runs; no NVIDIA card needed — simulate a big card to preview the pick.

title.en: Explains why it picks what it picks

body.zh: 挑选有据可查：精度保留为主轴，后端吞吐与显存余量只做破平；跑不了的配置不静默失败，会告诉你离放得下还差多少——是"差 16 GB"，不是一个干巴巴的"跑不了"。
body.en: The pick is auditable: accuracy retention leads, backend throughput and VRAM headroom only break ties; infeasible configs don't fail silently — they tell you how far off, "short by 16 GB", not a bare "won't run".

title.zh: 一条命令拉起，给你一个能用的端点
title.en: One command launches it, hands you a working endpoint

body.zh: 选好配置就自动拉起推理后端，流式输出日志，打印一个本地端点——任意客户端直连，你不用自己拼启动参数、不用搭服务。
body.en: Once the config is picked, it launches the inference backend, streams logs, and prints a local endpoint — any client connects directly; you don't assemble launch flags or stand up services.

body.zh: 每个模型的配置是版本化、硬件感知的数据条目——加一个量化下限或修一个对话模板引用只需改一行，无需碰代码；社区可提 PR，你也可以 fork 一份自己的配置表。
body.en: Each model's config is a versioned, hardware-aware data entry — adding a quant floor or fixing a chat-template reference is a one-line change, no code touched; the community can PR, and you can fork your own config table.

headline.zh: 一条命令，跑起前沿中文开源大模型
headline.en: One command to run a frontier Chinese open-source model

sub.zh: uv tool install zerorun，然后 zerorun deepseek-v4——首跑会下载权重，是等待不是操作。
sub.en: uv tool install zerorun, then zerorun deepseek-v4 — first run downloads weights, a wait not effort.

tag.zh: 5h → 1 命令 · 看清你的显卡，为前沿中文开源大模型自动选对配置并直接拉起 · MIT 开源
tag.en: 5h → 1 command · reads your GPU, picks the right config for frontier Chinese open-source models and just runs it · MIT open source
